content: Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad na igar-nabomaloed
Bemar abin-abin imakarmalale, ¿ibiga dummagan-Bab-Jesús-wissurmaladse be igar nabironaddamala? ¿Geg bemar Jesucristoʼgi-akananaimaladse igar-nabironamarsi?
Ar bemar Jesucristoʼgi-akananaimalad dule-we-napneggi-bukmaladga igar nabirogoed. Ar bemar wemarga igar-nabirogoedde, be-igar-burwiganadi, ¿geg na be nabomarde?
Deginbali, ¿ar bemar wissurmarbarsi, anmar baliwiturmarga igar-nabirogega gumaloed? Degisoggu, we-napneggined-igar-bursunna, sunna be nabomardo.
We-napneggined-igargangi be abin-abin imakarmalale, ¿ibiga dule-Bab-Jesúsʼba-naisurmalad bemarga igar-nabogega be imakdamala?
Bemar-obingegsaega an bemarga soged. ¿Ar bemar-abargi gwenadganga igar-nabogega gwenad-wargwensaar nue-binsaed-nikadaed sursi?
Emide, bemar dule-igar-nabomalad-Jesúsʼba-naisurmalad-asabin, gwenadgan-gwenadgan abin-abin na imakmargu. Mer deyob be damala.
Ar bemar na abin-abin-imaknanaidgine, bato na be nue-nosmalad. ¿Bur nuedinsursi, binsa dule be-wioarmalar? ¿Bur nuedinsursi, binsa dule bei ibmar atursasmalar?
Emide, bemar gwenadgangi binsa yoledimalad, degine, e-ibe ibmar atursadimalad. Deyob bemar be-gwenadgan-imakewilubsulid.
¿Ar be wissurmarsi, dulemar-igar-napira-imaksurmalad Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse dogosurmalad? Degisoggu, mer be yardaklemalo. Dule-Bab-negse-dogosurmalad, wemalad:

content.text: machergan na machered e-omega-imakmalad, omegan na ome e-macheredga-imakmalad.

content: Bemar epenne gwenna-gwenna deyob nanadii gusmalanad. Emigindi, bemar, gwage uruklesmalad, gwage-swilidik gusmalad, isgussuliyob Dummad-Jesús-nuggi, degi, Bab-Dummad-Burbagi bemar gunonimarsunnad.
Bemar-sangi Bab-Dummad-nug ogannomar
Belagwapa an sunna ibmar saedbiid. Degi-inigwele, belagwapa ibmar-nueganbi anga guosulid. Ar belagwapa sunna ibmar an sae-inigwele, ibmar an-nidiguega geg an imaked.

Deginbali, masgullegedi sabangalad. Sabanmoga, masgullegedgarmogad. Saban, degine, masgulleged, Bab-Dummad ebobela osulogoed. Anmar-sandina, negsichigi abirgunagwarsuli yolegegarsulid. Anmar-san, Bab-Jesúsʼga arbaegalad, degi, Bab-Jesús anmar-sangi na e-nug ogannolegegalad.
Bab-Dummad, igi-Bab-Jesús-burgwarmaigu, gannar odulosgusa, abayobi, gannar na e-ganguedgi Bab-Dummad anmar-san burgwarmai odulomogoed.
¿Ar be wissurmarsi, Cristoʼgi bemar-san akanaid? ¿An-san Cristoʼgaditega, degite, an-san ome-gambanuchuga-ukega an imakode? Suli, degisulid.
¿Ar be wissurmarbarsi, dule ome-gambanuchu na e-omega imaksar, ebogwad na san-wargwennagwadga gunonidaed? Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaid:
Génesis 2:24
Ar dule Bab-Jesúsʼgi akanonikile, burbaledgine, san-wargwennaa Bab-Jesúsʼba gunonidasunnad.
Degisoggu, negsichigi-yolegedgi be bangumarsun. Ar isgued-baidgi dule-wargwen isgusar, e-sangi isgussulid. Ar negsichigi-yolegeddi, na dukin e-sangi isgudiid.

¿Ar be wissurmarsi, bemar-san, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-e-neg gued? Bab-Dummad, E-Burba-Nued bemarga uksad. Emigindi, E-Burba-Nued bemargi maid. Degisoggu, bemar na bemargadsulid, bemar Bab-Dummadgadid.
Ar Bab-Dummad gargedgi bemar-baksad. Degisoggu, bemar-sangi, degi, bemar-burbagi, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomarsun, ar sogbobela, be-san, degi, be-burba, Bab-Dummadgad gued.
